items.title: The Mythical Man-Month in the Age of AI
items.summary: This article revisits the classic software engineering book 'The Mythical Man-Month' in the context of modern AI advancements, discussing how AI tools can alter project management and team dynamics. Developers and engineers should care because it highlights the evolving role of AI in enhancing productivity and decision-making in software projects.

items.title: Three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics
items.summary: Recent collaborative research has led to significant breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science, and physics, showcasing the power of interdisciplinary approaches. This is crucial for developers and engineers as it opens new avenues for innovation and problem-solving in technology.

items.title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False [pdf]
items.summary: A groundbreaking paper has disproven the Exponential Time Hypothesis, which has implications for computational complexity and algorithm design. This finding is significant for engineers and computer scientists as it challenges existing assumptions and could lead to more efficient algorithms.

items.title: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
items.summary: A security vulnerability was identified in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model, exposing cross-request KV cache data, which has been remediated. Developers should be aware of this issue to ensure they implement proper security measures in their AI models to protect sensitive data.

items.title: CSS-Tricks has a new owner
items.summary: CSS-Tricks, a well-known resource for web developers, has announced a change in ownership, which may lead to new content and direction for the platform. This is important for web engineers as it could influence the resources and tools available to them in the future.
